scope:
Byte-exact old/new residual-activation projection shared-activation microbenchmark.

Pinned control/candidate binaries use the same original-source Q8 planes and
FP16 inputs. Sampled FP64 gates, exact residual output bytes and CPU/event/wall
measurements precede any inference-performance claim. Not full-model quality.
dtype: FP16 input/output; original Q8/F16-scale weights. Original FP16 and residual A8 remain separate arithmetic profiles. Control/candidate residual math must be byte-identical.

unsupported_cases.reason: full activation staging >48KiB or not T1/T2
